candidate.browser: Google Chrome 153.0.8010.37 macOS arm64 (retained official artifact; not launched in this qualification)

verified_static_facts: connect_over_cdp attaches after the external browser is already running
set_offline, route, and add_init_script are BrowserContext operations available only after connection
the public connect_over_cdp signature has no persistent-context creation options for service_workers, timezone, locale, proxy, viewport, or downloads_path
BrowserContext routing does not intercept requests already handled by Service Workers
for an external CDP connection, Playwright browser close disconnects its transport and does not own the external Chrome process

g0_a.reason: No public pre-connection fail-closed mechanism covers restored pages, existing Service Workers, unfinished downloads, and managed requests while preserving the long-term default Context.

rejected_shortcuts: treating --no-startup-window as proof of zero background activity
installing the guard only after connecting
adding a parallel raw-CDP execution path
disconnecting before the owned Chrome process has stopped
falling back to the historical launch_persistent_context or site-specific path
unchanged: Profile binding and user creation default
Page, ControlLease, file material, Run, receipt, and unknown/no-replay semantics
the historical unknown_outcome/dispatched Chrome Run without file_ref
next_decision: Require a public, maintainable launch/connection capability that establishes fail-closed protection before browser startup while retaining persistent Context configuration, downloads, and lifecycle semantics; otherwise any network-layer or disposable-Profile alternative needs separate product scope and authorization.
